Sir/Madam, 
Subject: - Schedule of the Earnings Conference call – Q1 - FY27 Financial Results 
Pursuant to Regulation 30(2) of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 
2015, we wish to inform, that the Earnings call on the unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 
June 30, 2026 is scheduled to be held on Thursday, July 30, 2026 at 09:00 AM (IST). The details of the 
call are enclosed. No Unpublished Price Sensitive Information is intended to be discussed during the 
Meeting.  
Pursuant to Regulation 46(2) of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 
2015, this information will also be uploaded on website of the Company at Financial Reports – 
Redington (redingtongroup.com).  
We request you to kindly take the above information on record. 
Thanking you.  
For Redington Limited
